question: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Yojana was launched by the state of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Yojana is a scheme launched by the **Maharashtra government.**
 
• The scheme is aimed at **small and marginal farmers** who own cultivable land in Maharashtra.
 
• The Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Yojana was launched by the Government of Maharashtra under the leadership of **Devendra Fadnavis.**
 
• Under the scheme, farmers receive direct financial assistance through the **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism.**
